ownership.businessAuthority: Implemented Cloudflare Queue worker runtime for asynchronous event, notification, search, analytics, and outbox consumers declared in services/queue-workers/wrangler.toml.

observabilityAuthority.audit: job side effects must preserve event IDs and retry state

executionAuthority.executionRole: Execution container for APIs, workers, webhooks, schedulers, queue consumers, and runtime bootstrapping.
executionAuthority.service-local event helpersRole: Delegates business workflow sequencing to service-owned workflow adapters; owns transport invocation and runtime transactions only.
executionAuthority.infrastructureOwnership: May wire packages/infrastructure adapters to runtime bindings and secrets; does not import provider SDKs directly.
executionAuthority.eventOwnership: Owns runtime event ingestion, dispatch, acknowledgement, and handler execution for declared service responsibilities.
executionAuthority.queryOwnership: May execute service-side read models through service-owned workflow adapters or service-owned read planners contracts.
executionAuthority.compositionOwnership: No UI composition authority; composes execution handlers and response envelopes only.

service-local event helpersAuthority: Transport and handler invocation only; business service-local event helpers delegates to service-owned workflow adapters and event flow delegates to service-local event helpers.
eventAuthority: Owns runtime event ingress, handler execution, acknowledgement, and correlation propagation for this service boundary; event contracts live in service-local event helpers and packages/event-core.
workflowAuthority: Workflows, use cases, sequencing, and cross-domain coordination are owned by service-owned workflow adapters, not this runtime.
queryAuthority: Executes service-side reads through service-owned workflow adapters or service-owned read planners contracts; does not own cross-domain projection assembly.
compositionAuthority: Owns API, worker, webhook, scheduler, queue, and response-envelope composition only; no UI or business workflow composition.
executionOwnership: Execution container for APIs, workers, schedulers, queues, webhooks, event handlers, transport, and runtime bootstrapping only.
queueOwnership: Owns queue execution containers, retry scheduling, visibility timeout handling, dead-letter redrive, and worker coordination for declared service responsibilities using service runtime governance contracts contracts.
providerOwnership: May bind packages/infrastructure adapters to deployment secrets and runtime bindings; direct provider SDK imports are forbidden outside packages/infrastructure.
executionBoundaries: Execution-container boundary: APIs, workers, queues, schedulers, webhooks, runtime bootstrapping, and execution adapters only.
asyncExecutionOwnership: Owns runtime async containers only: queue consumers, webhook handlers, schedulers, and event workers while workflow policy delegates to service-owned workflow adapters/service-local event helpers.
observabilityOwnership: Propagates request, correlation, trace, and audit metadata across API, queue, webhook, scheduler, and execution adapter boundaries.
telemetryOwnership: Owns execution-container telemetry emission for traces, queue/workflow spans, metrics, structured logs, and correlation propagation using service runtime governance contracts contracts.
cacheOwnership: Owns service-side cache invalidation and projection cache coordination for declared runtime responsibilities; cache policy contracts live in service-owned read planners, service-owned read planners, and service runtime governance contracts.
auditOwnership: Owns execution audit emission for privileged runtime operations, provider execution authorization, queue redrive, and workflow recovery using service runtime governance contracts security contracts.
operationalOwnership: Owns execution-container operational wiring for runtime health, diagnostics, recovery service-local event helpers, deployment topology participation, and operational command handling.
telemetryExecutionOwnership: Owns execution-container telemetry emission for traces, metrics, structured logs, diagnostics, queue/workflow spans, and exporter abstraction wiring.
queueExecutionOwnership: Owns queue operational execution for inspection, recovery, retry service-local event helpers, visibility timeout repair, dead-letter redrive, partition balancing, and throughput diagnostics.
auditExecutionOwnership: Owns runtime audit execution for provider execution authorization, queue redrive, workflow recovery, tenant runtime operations, and control-plane commands.
cacheExecutionOwnership: Owns service-side cache execution for invalidation, stale-while-revalidate coordination, idempotency-aware invalidation, cache diagnostics, and tenant cache partitioning.
diagnosticsOwnership: Owns runtime diagnostics persistence for queue, workflow, cache, provider, tenant, telemetry, and deployment health.
operationalControlPlaneOwnership: Owns operational control-plane command execution for workflow, queue, diagnostics, provider resilience, telemetry, tenant runtime, governance, and recovery service-local event helpers.
deploymentOwnership: Owns production execution deployment wiring for Queue Workers; provider manifests are declared in runtime topology and service deployment config.
observabilityInfrastructureOwnership: Emits correlated runtime telemetry to the OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Tempo, Loki, and Grafana stack declared in infrastructure/observability.
queueProviderOwnership: Owns Cloudflare Queues consumer execution, dead-letter persistence, retry visibility, and queue telemetry for production queues.
incidentOwnership: Participates in incident metadata, diagnostics, alert routing, and audit records through production incident governance.
deploymentTopologyOwnership: Must match config/runtime/deployment-topology.json and config/runtime/production-topology.json; topology drift is a hard validation failure.
securityOwnership: Owns runtime secret binding, RBAC enforcement, audit emission, and operational authorization for service execution.
controlPlaneOwnership: Owns service-side operational command execution or projection through /v1/operations/runtime and runtime_control_commands.
productionOwnership: Owns production execution-container readiness, deployment health, runtime diagnostics, and operational recovery for this service boundary.
deploymentPipelineOwnership: Owns deployment pipeline gates through infrastructure/deployment, production-rollout workflow, health gates, rollback runbooks, and production topology validation.
telemetryInfrastructureOwnership: Owns telemetry infrastructure integration through OpenTelemetry, runtime telemetry tables, Prometheus alerts, and dashboard projections.
dashboardOwnership: Owns operational dashboard projection exposure through platform-console operations UI and Grafana dashboards without local fixture data.
operationalDashboardOwnership: Owns operational dashboard projection exposure through platform-console operations UI and Grafana dashboards without local fixture data.
